title: launch()
content: This call is synchronous. When it returns, the application launches and is ready to handle user events. The system reports any failure in the launch sequence as a test failure and halts the test at this point.
If the application is already running, this call terminates the existing instance, to ensure a clean launch state for the newly launched instance.

title: terminate()
content: Terminates any running instance of the application.
If the application has an existing debug session via Xcode, the debugger sends a command to terminate the application. Otherwise, an appropriate platform-specific mechanism terminates the process.

title: launchArguments
content: The arguments that pass to the application on launch.
If not modified, these are the arguments that Xcode passes to the application on launch. You can change, add to, or remove the arguments. Unlike with
, you can also modify these arguments after the application launches. Such changes don’t affect the current launch session, but do take effect the next time the application launches.
